description:
· Determines and analyzes integration by identifying tables, data elements in member’s Epic system that map to our Premier spec for various applications- primarily Quality, Operational tools
 · Analyzes raw data for structure, format, content, and relationships to ensure compatibility and requirements for the various analyses performed.
 · Develops and maintains scripts, regular expressions, and other data transformations needed to support data interfacing.
 · Provides documentation as needed (for example, spreadsheets of Epic tables/data elements mapped to associated Premier fields)
 · Serves as a SME with vendors, clients, and consultants to resolve data integration issues.
 · Builds and provides SQL and other database query technology for writing packages, functions, stored procedures, triggers and creating tables and indexes
 · Participates in project status meetings as needed and provide status reports using task tracking tools such as JIRA

 Minimum Requirements
 Bachelor's Degree required
 Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Math, Engineering, Informatics

 GOOD COMMUNICATION S 
 
 C2H
 
 H1B,OPT- EAD,GC or USC 
 
 DURATION:   6 + MONTHS
